newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul gold volume off sharply on slack demand.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul gold volume off sharply on slack demand.

text.p: Traded volume on Istanbul's gold exchange tumbled on Thursday on weak free market demand due to a weaker dollar/mark parity and uncertainty in world gold markets, dealers said on Thursday.
Traded volume was only 235 kilos, all in lira terms, down sharply from 1,335 previously.
Gold closed at 1,114,500 lira per gram, rising from Wednesday's 1,112,950 as the lira ended at 90,170 to the dollar after 90,110 yesterday.

"There were a few buyers. Worries that gold prices may go lower in world markets and an easier dollar/mark parity reduced demand," said Bulent Cubuklu from Rona foreign exchange and gold trade office.
Dealers said much of the free market demand was met earlier in the week when strong activity was recorded on the exchange.
